page.overview:
Who is Rok Buran?

Rok Buran was a human male Jedi Master active during the High Republic Era.

He led the Republic Pathfinder team Outer Rim Expedition Two-Five-Two, the other members of which were his Padawan Maliq, Joneth, Branda, and the communications droid EX-8C. the team was betrayed and ambushed during an expedition to the planet Gloam, with Buran left as the only survivor after being left for dead due to injuries inflicted by some of the planet's monsters. Buran made his way to an old Jedi temple on the planet, where he took shelter while sending out EX-8C with a distress signal which was discovered by Master Silandra Sho's Pathfinder team.

After leaving Aubadas, Buran joined another Pathfinder team onboard the Pathfinder ship Witherbloom. He talked to Xinith Tarl about losing his previous team on Gloam. Their ship came under attack and was rammed by a craft. The collision caused both ships to crash on a nearby planet. Buran helped Tarl who had become trapped under some debris and was injured. When the pilot Pako informed the Jedi that the ship was going to explode, he questioned Pako if the planet's atmosphere was safe. Realizing the danger, Buran picked up Tarl and fled the exploding ship along with the rest of the crew.

He put Tarl down and had the medic Ambar attend to the injured Bith. The rest of the team had a meeting and decided to check out the other crashed ship to see if there were any supplies or survivors. They made their way to the crash site and decided to split into teams to search the wreckage. Buran and Padawan Coron Solstus investigated the bridge. As they worked their way deeper into the ship, Buran was questioned by Solstus about the loss of Maliq. The pair got to the controls and started to reroute the power but were overcome by something that was clouding their senses.
